item.title: Indian Air Force AFCAT 01/2027 Online Form
item.description:
Post Name Total Posts Educational Qualification
Flying Branch 36 Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (minimum 50% marks each) and Graduation in any discipline (minimum 60% marks) or BE/B.Tech with 60% marks.
Ground Duty Technical – AE (L) 88 Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (minimum 50% marks each) and a minimum 4-year Engineering/Technology degree in the prescribed disciplines.
Ground Duty Technical – AE (M) 36 Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (minimum 50% marks each) and a minimum 4-year Engineering/Technology degree in the prescribed Mechanical/Aerospace-related disciplines.
Ground Duty Non-Technical – Weapon Systems 30 Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (minimum 50% marks each) and Graduation in any discipline (minimum 60% marks) or BE/B.Tech with 60% marks.
Ground Duty Non-Technical – Administration 53 Passed 10+2 and Graduation in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks.
Ground Duty Non-Technical – Logistics 11 Passed 10+2 and Graduation in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks.
Ground Duty Non-Technical – Accounts 8 B.Com / BBA (Finance) / BMS (Finance) / BBS (Finance) / CA / CMA / CS / CFA or B.Sc. Finance with the prescribed marks.
Ground Duty Non-Technical – Education 4 Graduation and Post-Graduation in the prescribed disciplines with the required marks.
Ground Duty Non-Technical – Meteorology 2 B.Sc. with Physics and Mathematics or a 4-year Engineering/Technology degree in the prescribed disciplines.
GATE Score Entry – AE (L) 11 BE/B.Tech in the prescribed Engineering/Technology disciplines with a valid GATE score as specified in the notification.
GATE Score Entry – AE (M) 5 BE/B.Tech in the prescribed Mechanical/Aerospace-related disciplines with a valid GATE score as specified in the notification.
NCC Special Entry As per allocation Graduation in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks and an NCC Air Wing Senior Division 'C' Certificate.
Total Vacancies 284 (Tentative)

Note: The above qualifications are brief summaries. Candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully for detailed educational qualifications, prescribed subjects, eligible degree disciplines, and other eligibility conditions.

item.title: UPPSC RO / ARO Vacancy 2026
item.description:
UPPSC RO / ARO Recruitment 2026 – Post-wise Vacancy and Educational Qualification Details
Post Name Total Posts Educational Qualification
Samiksha Adhikari (RO) 131
  • Bachelor's Degree from a University established by law in India.
  • Equivalent qualification recognized by the Government is also acceptable.
Samiksha Adhikari (Account) 31
  • Bachelor's Degree in Commerce with Accountancy.
  • 'O' Level Certificate in Computer Application from a Government-recognized Institute.
Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (ARO) 329
  • Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.
  • 'O' Level Certificate awarded by DOEACC Society or equivalent qualification.
  • Minimum Hindi Typing Speed of 25 words per minute.
  • Knowledge of English typing is preferable.
Note: For posts under Allahabad High Court, a Diploma in Computer Science from a recognized Institute/University or an 'O' Level Certificate is required.
Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Account) 6
  • Bachelor's Degree in Commerce with Accountancy.
  • 'O' Level Certificate in Computer Application from a Government-recognized Institute.
  • Knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari Script.
Manager 1
  • Bachelor's Degree from a University established by law in India.
  • Three Years Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering is preferable.
  • Knowledge of Horticulture and Accounts Rules is preferable.
  • Administrative experience is preferable.
Care-Taker 1
  • Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.
  • One-year course in Cookery, Bakery, Table Laying, Flower Arrangement or equivalent course is preferable.
  • Knowledge of Horticulture is preferable.
  • Knowledge of Accounts Rules and administrative experience is preferable.
Receptionist (Swagati) 1
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from a recognized University.
  • History, Geography, English Literature, Anthropology or Architecture must be one of the subjects at degree level.
  • Good knowledge of Hindi.
Store Keeper 1
  • Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.
  • Experience in maintenance of stores is preferable.
  • Commerce Graduates will be preferred.
Total 501 Posts

Note: For additional eligibility details and post-wise specific educational qualifications, candidates are advised to carefully read the official notification.
